rationale.f1: Sets the initial design frame but is largely restated with the actual causal mechanism in f2; losing it alone doesn't break the chain since f2 carries the operative detail.
rationale.f2: Root mechanism: the synchronous, connection-holding call is the initiating event of the whole chain.
rationale.f3: Necessary precondition: without an already-slow downstream API, synchronous waiting never produces timeouts.
rationale.f4: Direct causal link translating server-side synchronous wait into sender-side connection duration.
rationale.f5: Pivot event: this is where slow calls first turn into an externally visible failure (timeout).
rationale.f6: Necessary behavioral rule converting timeouts into retries; without it there is no loop at all.
rationale.f7: Restates the logical conclusion of f5+f6 (adds the 'every' quantifier) rather than introducing a new causal step.
rationale.f8: Explains why retries don't help: each retry re-hits the same slow endpoint synchronously, closing the loop.
rationale.f9: Core insight that reframes retries as adding load rather than relieving it — the crux of why this is a feedback loop, not routine retry noise.
rationale.f10: Closes the feedback loop: added pressure produces more timeouts and more retries, the self-reinforcing step.
rationale.f11: Useful for judging recurrence risk (the loop is latent even at normal load, just below the cascade threshold) but is context around the mechanism, not a new causal step in the chain.
rationale.f12: Describes the actual cascade dynamics under peak load — the observable failure the whole causal chain explains.
rationale.f13: A symptom/outcome of the cascade rather than a new causal step.
rationale.f14: Transitional link from diagnosed cause to remedy decision; important for narrative completeness but not part of the failure mechanism itself.
rationale.f17: Core mechanism of the fix: decoupling latency removes the causal link (f4) that started the whole chain.
rationale.f18: Direct, necessary consequence of decoupling — without this step the fix wouldn't stop timeouts.
rationale.f19: Final link showing why no retry is produced post-fix, which is what eliminates the loop's trigger (f6-f7).
rationale.f20: Distinguishes 'eliminated' from 'reduced' — directly relevant to the reader's stated task of judging whether the same loop could recur elsewhere versus merely being dampened here.
rationale.r7: Connects the diagnosed failure mechanism to the remedy decision; needed for the reader to see the causal narrative is complete and to evaluate whether the same reasoning transfers to other systems.
